stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 16, 17 & 18 - starting to look comfortable

stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 17 & 18 - the scorecard disagrees with the player

stories.detail: 7 1-pointers, zero wipes - a very niche skillset

stories.detail: 3 1-pointers straight - one point at a time, every time

stories.title: Very Consistent, Very One-Point
stories.detail: 9 1-pointers on the card - nailed the brief

stories.detail: 4 wipes in 18 holes - tough day at the office

comingLast.roast: 20 off 28 - some days the shots just are not enough
at 1.2 a hole he is on track for the full ceremony
1 from his last 1 - grandstand finish at the wrong end
current pace 1.3 a hole - the engraver is hovering
needs 4 from 6 - his playing group has started the commentary
averaging 1.4 a hole - the blue balls are warming up
still swinging on 18 - hope dies on the 18th, usually
the good news: 1 point saves him. the bad news: current form says 1.3 a hole
needs 1 in 3 - the kind of chase the bar was built for
the blue balls are patient - 3 holes is nothing to them
